description: Real-Time Sensor Network of Detroit Green Infrastructure: Datasets and Code is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Brooke E. Mason, Jacquelyn Schmidt (University of Michigan). MonitoredRainGardens_PaperTable.xlsx: Excel spreadsheet where the "Garden" sheet contains the 14 monitored green infrastructure (GI) sites with their design and physiographic features and the "Field Log" sheet contains the installation and field maintenance trips. WaterWells.xlsx: an Excel file containing all of the water wells in the Detroit region uses for interpolating groundwater levels. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
